name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport started unconventionally, trading a promising career in aerospace engineering for the adrenaline of the racetrack. After cutting his teeth as a data analyst for a small IndyCar team, his knack for spotting minute advantages quickly led to a strategist role. Jean-Pierre's approach blends rigorous data analysis with an intuitive understanding of race dynamics, allowing him to anticipate crucial moments and make calculated risks.

At Cadillac Racing, Jean-Pierre is valued for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to distill complex information into actionable strategies. He's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom, often proposing innovative solutions that have led to significant gains on the track. His dedication to continuous improvement and his collaborative spirit make him an invaluable asset to the team, constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium build, Jean-Pierre carries himself with a quiet confidence and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a Rubik's Cube and solves it during tense moments.
Has a collection of vintage racing posters in his office, each representing a different era of motorsport.
Insists on brewing his own strong French-press coffee every morning.
